$comment: High/critical npm advisories accepted by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry needs a GHSA id, the package npm reports it on, why it cannot reach Polaris, and an expiry date - an expired entry fails the gate again. Background and removal conditions: docs/dependencies.md.

accepted.reason: No fixed node-forge release (<=1.4.0, the latest). Pulled in by acme-client, which only uses forge to generate keys, build CSRs and parse PEM; it never verifies an RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature, the only affected function.

No fixed release. Reached only through whatsapp-web.js -> puppeteer -> proxy-agent, which uses FTP to download a browser; the bridge image sets PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD and runs the system Chromium, so no FTP listing is ever parsed.

No fixed release. Used only by @puppeteer/browsers to unpack a downloaded browser; the bridge never downloads one (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD, system Chromium), and Polaris extracts no user archive with it.

No fixed release. Used only by @puppeteer/browsers to unpack a downloaded browser; the bridge never downloads one (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD, system Chromium), and Polaris extracts no user archive with it.

No fixed release. Build- and install-time only: tailwindcss 3, patch-package and the diagram package's sass (watch mode, never used) expand glob patterns written in this repository, never a pattern from a request. The copy under dymo-api's tw-to-css sits on the SDK's sendEmail path, which Polaris never calls.

Two exact pins of 8.4.31 the root override does not reach: Next.js 15 (build time, on this repository's own stylesheets; fixed only in Next 16) and tw-to-css inside dymo-api, used only by the SDK's sendEmail path, which Polaris never calls.

@univerjs/core 0.25 pins nanoid 5.1.11 exactly, and npm does not apply an override to it. Univer calls generateRandomId with fixed positive sizes (4 to 21), never a negative one. Univer 1.x drops nanoid.
